title: How to Score Experts for One-Shot MoE Expert Pruning: A Systematic Formulation and Selection Principle
abstract: arXiv:2606.15716v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models reduce per-token computation through sparse expert activation, yet deployment still requires storing the full expert pool, making one-shot expert pruning a practical approach for reducing memory usage. Although effective, existing criteria are largely heuristic, and no single criterion is universally optimal. Thus, establishing a principle for selecting pruning criteria suited to different deployment objectives remains an important yet largely underexplored problem in one-shot expert pruning. To this end, we introduce a systematic formulation for one-shot MoE expert pruning organized around three factors: routing frequency, gate weighting, and activation strength. The formulation yields a criteria selection principle: task-agnostic pruning should favor routed-token-averaged, gate-free activation-based criteria, whereas task-specific pruning can benefit from retaining routing-frequency and gate

translated_title: 如何为单次MoE专家剪枝进行专家评分：系统性公式化与选择原则
translated_abstract: 混合专家语言模型通过稀疏的专家激活降低了每个token的计算量，然而部署时仍需存储完整的专家池，这使得单次专家剪枝成为降低内存使用的实用方法。尽管有效，现有的大多数评分标准都是启发式的，且没有任何单一标准在所有情况下都是最优的。因此，建立一个适用于不同部署目标的剪枝标准选择原则，仍然是单次专家剪枝领域中一个重要但尚未被充分探索的问题。为此，我们围绕三个因素——路由频率、门控权重和激活强度——引入了单次MoE专家剪枝的系统性公式化。该公式化得出了一个评分标准选择原则：任务无关的剪枝应优先采用基于路由token平均的、无门控的激活类标准，而任务特定的剪枝则可以通过保留路由频率和门控（信息）来获益……
tldr: 该论文提出了围绕路由频率、门控权重和激活强度三个因素对单次MoE专家剪枝进行系统性公式化的方法，并由此得出评分标准选择原则：任务无关剪枝应优先使用基于路由token平均的无门控激活标准，而任务特定剪枝则可从保留路由频率和门控信息中获益。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a systematic formulation of one-shot MoE expert pruning organized around three factors—routing frequency, gate weighting, and activation strength—and derives a criteria selection principle: task-agnostic pruning should favor routed-token-averaged, gate-free activation-based criteria, while task-specific pruning can benefit from retaining routing-frequency and gate information.
